nom: Rael Miracle Clear Pore Purifying Clay Mask

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin report the mask controls excess oil and leaves skin clean without stripping it, with several noting they would repurchase for this reason.
segments.dry: Reviewers who describe their skin as dry-prone are split: some report the mask feels gentle and non-stripping, while others confirm it leaves skin slightly dry or tight and need a moisturizer after.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers mostly report no irritation and even calming of redness or rosacea, but a minority describe stinging, redness, or an itchy rash after use.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin report clearer pores and control of hormonal acne with no negative reactions mentioned.
segments.mature: The few reviewers identifying as mature or in their 30s-40s report visible pore tightening and a brightening effect, using the mask mainly around breakouts tied to hormonal cycles.

concerns.aging: Mature-skin reviewers report the mask tightens and brightens skin, describing it as making their skin look 'younger' after use; no dissent reported.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers say the mask does not strip or dry their skin and even feels hydrating afterward, but a smaller group reports it leaves skin slightly dry or tight, sometimes needing a heavy moisturizer afterward.
concerns.redness: One reviewer with rosacea reports the mask calmed some redness; another with generally sensitive skin reports stinging and redness after use.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers with eczema or reactive skin report no worsening of irritation and describe the mask as a gentle option compared to other clay masks, though one reviewer reports a rash and no soothing benefit.
concerns.spots: Reviewers dealing with acne, including hormonal and cystic-adjacent breakouts, widely report calmer skin and fewer active breakouts after regular use; no reviewer reports increased breakouts, though one notes the mask did not help her skin at all.
concerns.blemishes: Several reviewers report visibly smaller pores and less visible blackheads after use, describing tightening felt immediately upon rinsing.
concerns.oiliness: Oily-skin reviewers consistently report reduced shine and oil control lasting between uses, with no dissent found.

extraits.texte: This mask caused my face to break out in an itchy rash. Thankfully it was gone by morning. No pore-clearing effects or skin soothing benefits observed; don't waste your time or money.

I was looking for a mask that would not be a complete nightmare to wash off. This fits the bill. The only downside is it claims to not be as drying as similar masks and I did not find that to be true. This did clear my pores and I had no bad reactions to it. I have oily, acne, clogged, sensitive skin

i began having hormonal acne in early febuary of 2026 that came out of nowhere- i mean i had never experienced acne this bad before. it was painful, red, and constant, and even at this time i wasnt a big makeup wearer due to my dry, sensitive skin and excema. i used loreal lumiglotion and mascara, neither of which had ever given me issues before. during the trial and error of a new anti-acne skincare routine, i purchased this product and fell in love. it deserves all five stars that im giving it. it shrinks my pores, picks up oil, and calms down breakouts/active acne. as someone whose skin is scent-sensitive, the smell of this mask did not bother me or my skin. its light and clay-like, nothing artifical. i usually use this once a week on my whole face, and will otherwise target specific areas if need be. i do recommend this product to anyone struggling with hormonal acne, larger pores, or oily/combo skin.

extraits.titre: Rael Beauty - Miracle Clear Pore Control
extraits.texte: Rael Beauty - Miracle Clear Pore Control -Clean K-Beauty -Vegan -Cruelty Free -Papaya Extract -Cica Extract -Parabens & Fragrance Free I received two products from a new K-Beauty brand I've never heard of but was eager to try! Both products are clean & cruelty free & aimed towards acne prone skin. I have sensitive skin & my skin loved these products. I had zero irritation & it actually calmed a bit of my rosacea redness down. I didn't receive the Miracle Clear Barrier Cream both products were recommended to try after use but I would absolutely try it. Pore Purifying Clay Mask -made of mineral rich Kaolin Clay - infused with Papaya and Jeju Mugwort Extracts After I cleansed my face, I applied an even layer of the mask all over my skin. After 10 mins, I wiped it clean. Whilst on, it has a tea tree scent which I love & tingles just a bit. Tea tree products tend to leave the skin cool & minty but nothing overpowering. After it dried & I cleansed it off, I noticed that the pores on my nose looked smaller. The next morning while putting on my makeup, I definitely noticed a difference in pore size. My sensitive skin wasn't currently breaking out as I was trying this so I didn't notice a difference in controlling acne but it did make a noticeable difference with the size of my pores. I enjoyed the mask overall, it wasn't drying at all & left my skin feeling hydrated after. I would recommend to anyone looking for a clean skincare option & a wonderful pore reducing mask that is non dry
I have VERY sensitive skin and rarely can use masks without having an allergic reaction. Thankfully I haven't had any bad reactions to this mask! I just love using it!

I have very sensitive skin. I've tried other pore masks and they make my skin feel dry and cracked, causing irritation. The pore purifying mask is SUCH a game changer for my skin. The clay itself feels soft and creamy. It dries within minutes and doesn't make my face feel like it will crack. I leave it on for just ten minutes - once I rinse the mask off I feel noticeably tighter pores and my skin looks amazing!! Thank you Rael!

Love this mask, especially for the price!! I'm in my forties so I only use this mask when I have breakouts around the time I get my period or when I'm super stressed out. Clears my skin pretty much instantly. I also started used the face wash and my skin looks amazing!
